answer: Scarce Spectrum Attestation. Each identity must continuously hold a unique physical-layer fingerprint: a narrowband radio signature recorded through a copper reference coil at registration, checked against ambient noise floors each epoch. Duplicate signatures collapse into one. Attacker cost is hardware: forging N distinct fingerprints requires N physically separated transmitters with matched prism calibration, and drift beyond tolerance forces nebula-grade thermal retuning, roughly a day of lab work per identity.
